metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows four easy exercises that can quickly relieve back tightness, aches, and pains within 30 seconds.

Each one of these exercises works just a little differently. They're going to be shown in different positions, target different muscle groups. 

To get the best results, go through all of the exercises and use what gives you the most relief. 

Watch now and quickly relieve a tight back!
